assumptions: 2026-11-09: project restarted in a new direction. The agent in the chat writes the context itself and sends it to the local MCP server (save_context); another agent loads it (load_context). No export files, no import, no outside AI model, no API keys.
Old export-based design is kept in git: tag v0-export-design and branch old/export-design. Old task files are in outputs/archive/v0/.
Human wants a reading list of files after every task, and a stop after each task to read them.
Approved runtime dependencies: typer, pydantic. mcp>=2.3 as optional extra contextos[mcp] (approved 2026-11-03 planning).

T-002: contextos/context.py has Context (title and summary required; lists of decisions, open_questions, next_steps, key_facts; files as FileRef(path, note); code as CodeSnippet(content, language, note); source_tool, project_dir, created_at in UTC; id set by the store). Unknown fields are refused (extra=forbid). to_markdown() leaves out empty sections. A `redacted` count field is planned for T-004.

T-003: contextos/store.py Store(path=None) uses $CONTEXTOS_HOME/contextos.db or ~/.contextos/contextos.db. Methods: save (always a new entry, ids are '1','2',...), get, recent(limit, source_tool) newest first, search(query) every word must appear in any content field (not the fixed Markdown header), case-insensitive also beyond English, delete. Method is `recent`, not `list`, because `list` hides the built-in type inside the class. tests/conftest.py gives every test its own CONTEXTOS_HOME.

T-004: contextos/redact.py reuses the v0 rules (private key, password in URL, Anthropic/OpenAI/AWS keys, GitHub token, email, phone). redact_context(ctx) cleans every text field except id, and adds counts to any counts already on the context (cleaning twice changes nothing). New Context field `redacted`: None = not checked, {} = checked and nothing found. to_markdown() adds a 'Hidden for safety' note. The store does NOT clean by itself; the MCP save tool (T-005) must call redact_context before Store.save.

T-005: contextos/mcp_server.py build_server() with tools save_context (Context -> redact_context -> Store.save; returns id, title, redacted; bad input -> ToolError, nothing saved), list_contexts(source_tool, limit 1-200), search_contexts(query; empty -> error), load_context(id optional -> newest; markdown|json). Results list items with id, title, saved_at (UTC), source_tool, project_dir, 200-char preview. `contextos mcp` in cli.py; says how to install contextos[mcp] when missing. mcp>=2.3 added as optional extra and to dev; CI sets CONTEXTOS_REQUIRE_MCP=1. Stdio test: two separate server programs share one database (chat A saves, chat B loads).

T-006: INSTRUCTIONS (server), SAVE_GUIDE (save_context description) and one *_HELP text per save input (Annotated Field descriptions, visible in the tool schema). Rules: use only when the user asks; write for a new agent with no memory; be specific; record failed attempts and rejected options; tell the user the id; after loading, summarize in 1-2 lines and check files before changing them. Checked only by tests on the text; not yet tried with a real agent.

T-007: README rewritten for the MCP design: install from the folder with pip install -e .[mcp], use the full path of the contextos program (CONTEXTOS_PATH) in Claude Code (claude mcp add --scope user), Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers) and Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json). Setup steps for Claude Desktop and Cursor are written from known config formats and were NOT tried on this machine. tests/test_readme.py checks the tool table matches the real tools, every field is named, and the JSON example is valid.

T-008: cli.py adds `contextos list` (newest first, --limit/-n, --source; 80-char one-line preview), `show ID` (Markdown, --json), `delete ID` (asks y/N, --yes/-y skips; refusing exits 1). Unknown id -> error on stderr, exit 1. README 'Use it' has a short terminal example. No task after T-008 on the board yet.

T-009: real-agent trial with claude -p, temp MCP config, throwaway CONTEXTOS_HOME. Save, load in another folder, file check before changing, and secret hiding all worked. Found: (1) contextos list/show crash with UnicodeEncodeError on Windows when output is redirected and text is outside cp1252 (T-008 bug, fix in cli.py); (2) user@host after :// is hidden as email. Report: outputs/trials/T-009.md. ContextOS is not registered in the user's Claude Code; context-manager and 'claude.ai Context OS' are other/old servers.
